source.reason: BLOCK b0015 lists Fe-25Mn-7Al-0.9C-0.50Zr (wt.%) referred to as Zr0.50 steel, the highest Zr addition level that produces the bimodal heterogeneous grain structure studied in the paper.

paper.paper_scope: The paper designs a single-phase heterogeneous (bimodal) grain structure in Fe-Mn-Al-C low-density steels by tuning Zr content (0, 0.01, 0.50 wt%) under a fixed thermo-mechanical treatment (80% cold rolling + 900 °C/5 min annealing + water quenching), and investigates how Zr solute drag and ZrC Zener pinning retard recrystallization to produce coarse/fine grain zones that improve strength-ductility synergy via HDI hardening, dislocation slip and nanotwinning.
paper.title: Promoting strength-ductility synergy by heterogeneous grain structure in a zirconium-alloyed Fe-Mn-Al-C low-density steel

processes.description: Full thermo-mechanical treatment applied to all three Fe-Mn-Al-C steels: as-cast homogenization at 1200 °C for 2 h, hot rolling with 40% thickness reduction followed by water quenching, cold rolling with 80% reduction, then annealing at 900 °C for 5 min followed by water quenching; this is the pre-deformation terminal state of all studied samples.
processes.process_name: Thermo-mechanical treatment: homogenization 1200 °C/2 h + 40% hot rolling + WQ + 80% cold rolling + 900 °C/5 min annealing + WQ
processes.processes_notes: The identical TMT is applied to Zr0, Zr0.01 and Zr0.50 steels; the alloys differ only by Zr content, so the process is shared and only the alloy distinguishes the samples.

source.reason: Combination of the Zr-free alloy (Zr0 steel, BLOCK b0015) with the shared TMT process (BLOCK b0015, b0038); its annealed microstructure is composed of coarse recrystallized FCC grains (BLOCK b0020) and it shows YS ~435 MPa, UTS 820 MPa, ductility 52 % (BLOCK b0027).

Combination of the 0.01 wt% Zr alloy (Zr0.01 steel, BLOCK b0015) with the shared TMT process (BLOCK b0015, b0038); its annealed microstructure consists of coarse FCC grains and few fine FCC grains (BLOCK b0020) with YS ~450 MPa, UTS ~832 MPa and ductility 55 % (BLOCK b0027).

Combination of the 0.50 wt% Zr alloy (Zr0.50 steel, BLOCK b0015) with the shared TMT process (BLOCK b0015, b0038); it exhibits a single-phase bimodal heterogeneous grain structure with CG and FG zones (BLOCK b0020, b0064) and yields YS ~505 MPa, UTS ~855 MPa and ductility 58 % (BLOCK b0027).

unmapped_findings: The Zr0.50 steel's bimodal heterostructure consists of soft coarse grain zones (~5 μm, 65 % area) and hard fine grain zones (~1 μm, 35 % area), attributed to retarded recrystallization via Zr solute drag and Zener pinning of nanoscale ZrC (~30 nm).

Quantitative strengthening contributions for the Zr0.50 steel: grain boundary + HDI strengthening ~300 MPa, Orowan precipitation strengthening by ZrC ~108 MPa; estimated SFE of FCC matrix ~55 mJ/m2 and critical twinning stress ~1.14 GPa.

Deformation mechanisms in the Zr0.50 steel include planar slip/dislocation slip, slip bands along {111} planes, ~20 nm nanotwins, and interaction of dislocations with ZrC particles; HDI hardening and deformation twins control strain hardening and ductility.
